title: Leveraging large language models (LLMs) to enhance student inquiry in a nanochemistry teaching laboratory: a Fenton-like oxidation using recyclable ferrite nanoparticle (NP) catalysts
content:
RSC Sustainability, 2026, Advance Article
DOI: 10.1039/D6SU00221H, Paper
Open Access
  This article is licensed under a Creative Commons Attribution-NonCommercial 3.0 Unported Licence.
Jacob E. Daniel, Alex Barnosky, Ethan J. Crace, Abhinandan Banerjee
A course-based UG research experience described here integrates LLMs in the study of ferrite nanoparticles. Ethical use of LLMs to optimize synthesis, interpret complex characterization data, and study catalytic dye degradation fosters digital fluency.
